data.text:
Del Monte Foods Pvt. Ltd vs Addl. District Magistrate Budgam 
And ... on 20 March, 2024 
Author: Wasim Sadiq Nargal
Bench: Wasim Sadiq Nargal
 S. No. 119
 Regular Cause List
 In The High C0Urt 0F Jammu & Kashmir And Ladakh
 At Srinagar
 Wp (C) No. 2897/2023
 Cm No. 6897/2023
 Cm No. 6898/2023
 Cm No. 834/2024
Del Monte Foods Pvt. Ltd. ...Appellant/Petitioner(s)
Through: None
 Vs.
Addl. District Magistrate Budgam and Ors. ...Respondent(s) 
Through: Mr. Satinder Singh Kala, AAG CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE WASIM SADIQ NARGAL, JUDGE  ORDER 20.03.2024 CM(834/2024) This is an application by the Respondent No. 2, seeking transfer of the writ petition WP(C) 2897/2023 to the Food Safety Appellate Tribunal. 
Mr. Satinder Singh Kala, the learned Additional Advocate General submits that the Government has issued a notification dated 15th December, 2023, being S.O 616, in exercise of the power conferred under sub-section (3) of Section 70 of the Food Safety & Standards, Act 2006 read with Rule 3.2.1 of the Food Safety & Standards Rules, 2011 and accordingly, appointed the following Presiding Officers for Food Safety Appellate Tribunal, Kashmir and Food Safety Appellate Tribunal, Jammu.
Jurisdiction Presiding Officer Kashmir Shri. Shujat Al Khan S/O Usman Ali Khan R/O Village Naloosa, Tehsil Boniyar Sub Division Uri, District Baramulla.
Jammu Shri Ramesh Kumar Wattal S/O Lt. Shri Jagar Nath Wattal R/O House No. 69, Durga Nagar Enclave Sector,1 Jammu.
Del Monte Foods Pvt. Ltd vs Addl. District Magistrate Budgam And ... on 20 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/7981440/
1 Mr. Satinder Singh Kala, the learned Additional Advocate General submits that in the light of the notification issued by the Government, this Court lacks inherent jurisdiction to adjudicate the instant writ petition any further and as such, the instant writ petition needs to be transferred to the Food Safety Appellate Tribunal, Kashmir, for adjudication. He further submits that the petitioner has to approach the said Tribunal by way of an appeal under Section 70 of the Food Safety &
Standards, Act 2006 against the order of the Adjudicating Officer, which is under challenge in the present writ petition. 
In the above background, this writ petition is disposed of with liberty to the petitioner to approach the Food Safety Appellate Tribunal, Kashmir, with an appeal against the Order impugned within a period of six weeks from the date of passing of this Order and till that time, the operation of the impugned Order dated 17th October, 2023 bearing File No. 451, imposing penalty of Rs. 5 lacs shall remain in abeyance. 
In the event of default on the part of the petitioner to lay the requisite appeal on or before the expiry of time so granted, the interim direction hereby granted shall stand vacated. Disposed of. 
(Wasim Sadiq Nargal) JUDGE SRINAGAR 20.03.2024 Sakeena Del Monte Foods Pvt. Ltd vs Addl. District Magistrate Budgam And ... on 20 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/7981440/
